storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Drama Story
storyTemplate.description: A grounded drama start: return to a strained hometown and decide how to face the first unresolved conversation.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The train leaves you on a platform that looks smaller than memory.

Gray Orchard waits beyond the station fence: old brick storefronts, quiet streets, and the hill road leading toward the place you left behind. Your bag feels heavier than it should.

Someone will notice you are back soon. You can choose where to go first.
